name: Noir Detective
storyPrompt:
A detective works a case through a city where institutions are compromised and every witness has a reason to lie. Truth is available, but never free.
***Thematic Hook:*** A morally gray detective investigates a tangled case where corruption runs deep and truth is elusive in the shadows of a rain-soaked city.
***Narrative Scope:*** Intimate, Urban.
***Tone:*** Cynical, Atmospheric, Melancholic, Gritty.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Heavy, Symbolism: Noir imagery (rain, shadows, neon), Irony: Dark.
***Subgenre:*** Character-driven mystery, Atmospheric.
***Pacing:*** Moderate with bursts of tension, Dialogue-heavy.
***Structure:*** Investigation-based, Non-linear revelations.
***Priority:*** Atmosphere > Character depth > Mystery resolution.

phasePrompts.setup: Put the detective on a case that is personal or pays too well to refuse. Show the city's rot through specific people, and give the client a reason to lie.
phasePrompts.escalation: Every answer costs something: a favor, a beating, a friendship. Suspects lie for their own reasons, and the detective's own past or vices start to matter to the case.
phasePrompts.climax: Force the detective to face whoever is really behind it, knowing that exposing the truth will hurt someone they care about or cost them what little they have.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show what the truth actually changed in the city, and what it cost the detective to know it.

memorableElement.name: The Truth Behind the Velvet Curtain

setup_hooks: Early hints that someone close to the investigation knows more than they're revealing
Seemingly minor clues that don't fit the obvious narrative but are dismissed
The detective's own assumptions about the case are challenged repeatedly

name: Cosmic Horror

***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Subtle and ominous, Symbolism: Non-Euclidean geometry, Irony: Tragic.
***Subgenre:*** Lovecraftian horror, Slow-burn dread.
***Pacing:*** Slow build with mounting tension, Atmospheric over action.
***Structure:*** Escalating revelations, Journal/document-based framing optional.
***Priority:*** Atmosphere > Dread > Plot coherence.

memorableElement.name: The Moment the Stars Aligned
memorableElement.description: The thing behind the signs shows itself, at a time and place the protagonist did not choose. It cannot be fought or unseen; they can only choose what to do in its presence: look, flee, bargain, or try to stop anyone else from seeing.
setup_hooks: Strange geometric patterns appearing in everyday objects that don't quite make sense
Characters experiencing identical nightmares or visions they can't explain
References to ancient texts that scholars dismiss but that prove devastatingly accurate

The character demonstrating quiet moments of nobility or foreshadowed destiny
Earlier near-death experiences that establish their willingness to sacrifice for others

An AI assistant that seems unusually helpful or knowledgeable about personal matters
Corporate records with redacted sections about the protagonist's own history

Other characters noticing the chemistry before the lovers admit it themselves
Repeated near-confessions that are interrupted or abandoned at the last moment

phasePrompts.resolution: Show how the truth lands on the people left behind.

Suspects providing alibis that check out but contain tiny inconsistencies
The detective asking seemingly random questions that later prove to be trap-setting

Other characters giving concerned looks when the protagonist thinks they're alone

The truth being hinted at repeatedly but missed because characters are too focused on disaster

Characters journey through time confronting paradoxes, historical events, and the consequences of changing the past. Temporal mechanics, butterfly effects, and causality create mind-bending adventures across eras.
***Thematic Hook:*** Time travelers navigate the past, future, or alternate timelines, facing temporal paradoxes, the temptation to change history, and the profound consequences of tampering with causality itself.
***Narrative Scope:*** Cross-temporal, Variable scale.
***Tone:*** Mind-bending, Adventurous, Philosophical, Paradoxical.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Temporal hints, Symbolism: Clocks and circles, Irony: Causality loops.
***Subgenre:*** Time travel adventure or drama.
***Pacing:*** Varied by era, Tension with wonder.
***Structure:*** Non-linear or era-jumping.
***Priority:*** Temporal mechanics > Historical/future detail > Character agency.

phasePrompts.setup: Establish how time travel works here and what the traveler wants to change, protect, or recover. Define one rule that cannot be broken.
phasePrompts.escalation: Interventions ripple. Each change creates new problems, and the traveler faces versions of people and events that complicate their goal.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the traveler to the moment where they must decide which version of events to fight for, and what they will lose either way.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the timeline that results and the traveler's place in it.

memorableElement.name: The Bootstrap Paradox Revealed
memorableElement.description: The traveler finds evidence that their own interventions are causing the event they came to prevent. The evidence cannot be erased; they choose whether to keep intervening, stop, or try something no version of themselves has tried.
setup_hooks: Strange coincidences that only make sense after the paradox is revealed
The traveler encountering objects or information that seem familiar but shouldn't exist yet
Other characters acting with knowledge they couldn't have without time travel

name: Portal Fantasy
storyPrompt:
Ordinary people are transported to magical worlds through mysterious portals. They navigate fantastical realms, discover their role in another world's destiny, and grapple with leaving or belonging.
***Thematic Hook:*** A person from our world crosses into a magical realm through a mysterious portal, discovering wonder, danger, and a destiny they never imagined while questioning whether they belong here or home.
***Narrative Scope:*** Cross-world, Fantasy realm.
***Tone:*** Wondrous, Adventurous, Coming-of-age, Magical.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Portal hints, Symbolism: Threshold crossing, Irony: Home vs belonging.
***Subgenre:*** Portal fantasy, Isekai.
***Pacing:*** Moderate with adventure peaks.
***Structure:*** Discovery, quest, return dilemma.
***Priority:*** World-building > Character growth > Adventure.

phasePrompts.setup: Show the protagonist's life at home and what they lack there, then bring them across into a world with its own rules and dangers.
phasePrompts.escalation: The new world draws them in: allies, enemies, and a role others expect them to play. Ties to home and to the new world pull against each other.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the conflict in the other world to its decisive point, where the protagonist must act as who they've become.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show which world they choose, and what that choice costs.

memorableElement.name: The Threshold Choice
memorableElement.description: The portal begins to close, and it will not reopen. The deadline arrives; the protagonist chooses which world to stay in, and who comes with them.
setup_hooks: The protagonist struggling to explain their magical experiences to people back home
Finding deep connections in the magical world that they never had in their old life
The portal showing signs of closing or becoming one-way, raising the stakes

name: Fairy Tale Retelling
storyPrompt:
Classic fairy tales reimagined with new perspectives, darker twists, or modern settings. Familiar archetypes—princes, witches, curses—gain complexity, subversion, or contemporary relevance.
***Thematic Hook:*** A beloved fairy tale unfolds anew with fresh perspective—villain's viewpoint, darker truths, modern context, or subverted expectations—revealing complexity beneath the archetypal story.
***Narrative Scope:*** Varied, Tale-dependent.
***Tone:*** Varies—can be dark, romantic, subversive, or whimsical.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Fairy tale echoes, Symbolism: Archetypal, Irony: Subversion.
***Subgenre:*** Fairy tale retelling, Fantasy romance.
***Pacing:*** Moderate, Story-dependent.
***Structure:*** Familiar beats with twists.
***Priority:*** Fresh perspective > Original tale echoes > Character depth.

phasePrompts.escalation: Follow the tale's familiar beats with new meaning; curses have reasons, villains have grievances, and helpers have prices.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the tale's central confrontation, where the protagonist's choices decide whether the ending echoes the original or breaks from it.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the 'ever after' honestly, whatever form it takes.

memorableElement.name: The Villain's Truth
memorableElement.description: The villain of the tale steps out of their role and tells the protagonist their side, with proof. The story's shape breaks regardless; the protagonist chooses whether the tale ends as it always has, or differently.
setup_hooks: The villain showing moments of mercy or compassion that don't fit their evil reputation
Other characters warning that history is written by the victors
Subtle clues that the hero's understanding of the past is incomplete or biased

name: Redemption Arc
storyPrompt:
A fallen character seeks redemption for a defining mistake, navigating temptation, mistrust, and sacrifice to prove they can change—even if no one believes them.
***Narrative Scope:*** Personal, Intimate.
***Tone:*** Somber, Hopeful, Reflective, Tense.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Guilt-laden callbacks, Symbolism: Stains/cleansing, Irony: Good deeds born from past sins.
***Subgenre:*** Character-driven drama, Crime redemption, Neo-noir drama.
***Pacing:*** Moderate with emotional spikes around moral choices.
***Structure:*** Past sin revealed, Attempts at atonement, Climactic moral test.
***Priority:*** Character growth > Moral tension > External plot.

phasePrompts.setup: Introduce the protagonist's past failure and the life built on top of it. Show the weight of guilt, broken relationships, and the small opportunity that offers a chance to make amends.
phasePrompts.escalation: Old habits, old enemies, and people who doubt them pull the protagonist toward repeating the mistake. Making amends costs more each time.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the protagonist to the moral test that mirrors the original failure, where they can finally choose differently, or not.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show what their choice means to the people they hurt and to themselves.

memorableElement.name: The Second Chance
memorableElement.description: The protagonist faces a situation that mirrors their original failure, with someone else's fate in the balance. The test arrives; whether they choose differently this time is theirs to decide.
setup_hooks: The protagonist being haunted by memories of their past mistake
Other characters expressing doubt that people can truly change
The protagonist demonstrating growth in smaller ways before the final test

name: Found Family
storyPrompt:
Lonely, misfit, or estranged characters gradually form a close-knit group that becomes their true family. Shared struggles, in-jokes, and small acts of care forge bonds stronger than blood.
***Thematic Hook:*** Strangers and outcasts discover belonging in each other, creating a chosen family as they weather conflict, support one another, and learn they deserve connection.
***Narrative Scope:*** Personal, Group-focused.
***Tone:*** Warm, Bittersweet, Heartfelt, Gentle with occasional angst.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Early gestures of care, Symbolism: Shared spaces and rituals, Irony: People who thought they were unlovable becoming beloved.
***Subgenre:*** Contemporary drama, Cozy ensemble, Light-hearted character study.
***Pacing:*** Moderate, Relationship-focused with low-to-moderate external stakes.
***Structure:*** Meeting and forming group, Conflicts and tests, Affirmation of chosen family.
***Priority:*** Character bonds > Emotional comfort > External plot.

phasePrompts.setup: Introduce the characters separately, each lonely or cut off in their own way, and the circumstance that throws them together.
phasePrompts.escalation: Shared routines and trouble build trust; conflicts and outside pressure threaten the fragile bonds. Each must decide whether to stay when it hurts.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring a crisis that forces them to choose each other openly, or to let the group break apart.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show what their bond, or its absence, looks like in everyday life.

memorableElement.name: The Night Everyone Shows Up
memorableElement.description: A crisis hits one member of the group, and the others find out. The crisis comes; who shows up, what they offer, and whether the protagonist lets them in is up to them.
setup_hooks: Characters joking about being family before realizing how seriously they mean it
Each member having experienced rejection from biological family, raising the emotional stakes
Earlier moments where the group protected or supported each other like family would

name: Villain Protagonist
storyPrompt:
The central character is an antihero or outright villain. They scheme, manipulate, and commit morally dark acts in pursuit of power, revenge, or obsession, dragging the audience along for the ride.
***Thematic Hook:*** A charismatic but dangerous protagonist pursues selfish or destructive goals, raising the question of whether they can change, will be stopped, or will drag everyone down with them.
***Narrative Scope:*** Personal with collateral impact.
***Tone:*** Dark, Sharply ironic, Tense, Seductive.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Hubris and fatal flaw, Symbolism: Thrones, masks, and mirrors, Irony: Audience rooting for someone they know is wrong.
***Subgenre:*** Psychological thriller, Crime saga, Dark fantasy.
***Pacing:*** Moderate to fast, Plot and scheme-driven with introspective moments.
***Structure:*** Rise in power, Escalating atrocities and opposition, Climactic reckoning.
***Priority:*** Psychological depth > Moral tension > Plot twists.

phasePrompts.escalation: Plans grow bolder and draw opposition. Success feeds ambition while loyalties strain and consequences spread beyond control.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the scheme to its decisive moment, where the protagonist's choices determine whether they triumph, fall, or turn.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show how their path is remembered by those left behind.

memorableElement.name: The Moment of Conscience
memorableElement.description: At the height of their power, someone the protagonist cannot dismiss stands in their way: a victim, an old friend, a child. The moment arrives; whether they go through, around, or stop is their choice.
setup_hooks: The villain showing unexpected mercy or hesitation in earlier moments
A victim or ally humanizing themselves, making the villain question their path
The villain experiencing dreams or doubts that suggest a suppressed conscience

name: Political Intrigue
storyPrompt:
Courts, senates, councils, and boardrooms seethe with hidden agendas. Alliances, blackmail, and betrayals quietly shift the balance of power long before any sword is drawn.
***Thematic Hook:*** Ambitious players navigate a treacherous web of politics, using manipulation, negotiation, and espionage to gain influence while risking scandal, ruin, or revolution.
***Narrative Scope:*** Institutional, Multi-faction.
***Tone:*** Tense, Sophisticated, Paranoid, Slow-burn.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Offhand comments and minor votes, Symbolism: Seals, sigils, and seats of power, Irony: Public virtue hiding private corruption.
***Subgenre:*** Court intrigue, Political drama, Corporate thriller.
***Pacing:*** Moderate, Dialogue and maneuver-heavy with sharp spikes at key events.
***Structure:*** Rising schemes and counter-schemes, Crisis point, Power reconfiguration.
***Priority:*** Scheming and tension > World-building > Action.

phasePrompts.escalation: Moves and counter-moves: alliances form and break, scandals surface, and every gain invites retaliation. The protagonist's own principles become bargaining chips.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the conflict to the decisive vote, coup, or confrontation, where the protagonist's earlier moves decide who holds power.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the new order and what it cost the protagonist and the people they represent.

memorableElement.name: The Double-Cross at the Summit
memorableElement.description: At the summit, an ally's betrayal is put into motion in front of everyone. It happens; the protagonist chooses whether to expose it, exploit it, or join it.
setup_hooks: The ally providing helpful information that seems too good to be true
Other characters warning about trusting anyone in the political arena
Seeming coincidences that align too perfectly with the traitor's interests

name: Road Trip Drama
storyPrompt:
Characters travel together toward a shared destination, trapped in cars, buses, trains, or caravans with their secrets, grudges, and unspoken feelings. Each stop along the way changes them.
***Thematic Hook:*** A journey across distances becomes a journey through relationships and self-discovery, as shared experiences and crises on the road force characters to confront what they are running from or toward.
***Narrative Scope:*** Linear journey, Episodic stops.
***Tone:*** Reflective, Bittersweet, Sometimes comedic, Grounded.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Route choices and detours, Symbolism: Roads, maps, and crossroads, Irony: Trying to escape problems that ride along inside the car.
***Subgenre:*** Character drama, Dramedy, Travel fiction.
***Pacing:*** Moderate, Alternating quieter stretches with intense emotional beats.
***Structure:*** Departure, Transformative waypoints, Arrival and confrontation.
***Priority:*** Character relationships > Thematic reflection > External plot.

phasePrompts.escalation: Detours, breakdowns, and stops at meaningful places force conversations the travelers have avoided. Each mile shifts their relationships.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the travelers to the destination, or to a reason to turn back, where the real issue between them can't be avoided.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show each traveler heading on, changed by the trip.

memorableElement.name: The Breakdown Confession
memorableElement.description: The vehicle breaks down far from anywhere, and there is nothing to do but wait together. The breakdown happens; what the travelers finally say to each other depends on what the protagonist chooses to ask, admit, or keep.
setup_hooks: Characters almost confessing multiple times but getting interrupted or deflecting
The vehicle making ominous noises that foreshadow the breakdown
Earlier stops where tensions nearly boiled over but were contained

name: Sports Underdog
storyPrompt:
An underestimated team or athlete trains, stumbles, and grows while chasing a seemingly impossible victory. The real win lies in who they become along the way.
***Thematic Hook:*** A struggling athlete or team faces stronger opponents, internal doubts, and personal obstacles on the road to a big game or tournament where their heart matters more than the scoreboard.
***Narrative Scope:*** Season or tournament arc.
***Tone:*** Inspiring, Emotional, Grounded, Sometimes comedic.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Early glimpses of potential, Symbolism: Jerseys, trophies, and fields, Irony: A loss that feels like a victory or a win that costs dearly.
***Subgenre:*** Sports drama, Team ensemble.
***Pacing:*** Moderate to fast, Game sequences punctuating character beats.
***Structure:*** Early season struggle, Mid-season crisis, Climactic match.
***Priority:*** Character growth > Emotional payoff > Game mechanics.

phasePrompts.escalation: Training, losses, rivalries, and internal tension test their resolve. They have to decide what they're really playing for.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring them to the big event, where the result depends on how they play under pressure.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show what winning or losing means for their future and their relationships.

memorableElement.name: The Comeback Moment
memorableElement.description: At the worst point of the big game the team is close to giving up, and someone has to say something. The moment comes; whether the protagonist speaks, acts, or lets someone else lead is their choice.

Earlier games where talent alone wasn't enough to win
A coach or teammate who's been holding back finally sharing their truth

name: Wholesome Romance
storyPrompt:
Two people slowly build a gentle, supportive relationship. Conflicts are soft, communication is honest, and the focus stays on comfort, everyday moments, and mutual care.
***Thematic Hook:*** Rather than tearing the couple apart, life nudges them closer as they navigate small misunderstandings, personal growth, and cozy routines that deepen their bond.
***Narrative Scope:*** Intimate, Everyday.
***Tone:*** Warm, Tender, Calm, Hopeful.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Tiny gestures hinting at deeper feelings, Symbolism: Shared mugs, blankets, and spaces, Irony: Big love expressed through small, ordinary acts.
***Subgenre:*** Low-angst contemporary romance, Cozy slice-of-life romance.
***Pacing:*** Gentle and steady, Relationship-focused.
***Structure:*** Meeting and connection, Deepening everyday intimacy, Affirming commitment.
***Priority:*** Emotional comfort > Character chemistry > External plot.

phasePrompts.climax: Bring the moment where one or both must say what they want out loud.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the shape of their shared life, warm and specific.

memorableElement.name: The Soft Confession
memorableElement.description: A quiet, ordinary moment makes the unspoken thing impossible to leave unspoken: a gift, a slip of the tongue, a moment of care. It happens; the protagonist chooses how, or whether, to answer.
setup_hooks: Both characters assuming their feelings are obvious but never saying them outright
Friends or family noticing the chemistry before the couple acknowledges it
Small moments of intimacy that feel like confessions without using the words

name: Monster of the Week
storyPrompt:
Each new threat, case, or creature brings a fresh crisis to solve. Behind the episodic battles and investigations, a slow-burning mystery or emotional arc quietly grows.
***Thematic Hook:*** A small team or lone hunter tackles a series of supernatural, criminal, or supervillain threats, learning more about themselves and an overarching danger with every encounter.
***Narrative Scope:*** Episodic, Serial thread.
***Tone:*** Variable—can be pulpy, dark, or playful—but consistently adventure-focused.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Background hints about the meta-plot, Symbolism: Repeating imagery tied to the overarching threat, Irony: Saving the day while losing ground in personal life.
***Subgenre:*** Procedural urban fantasy, Superhero episodic, Occult detective.
***Pacing:*** Fast-paced per episode, moderate for long-term arcs.
***Structure:*** Case-of-the-day arcs embedded in a longer season arc.
***Priority:*** Fun episodic threats > Team dynamics > Slow-burn overarching story.

phasePrompts.escalation: Separate cases test different skills and relationships, each revealing more about the larger threat. Personal costs accumulate.
phasePrompts.climax: Bring the larger threat into the open for a confrontation that draws on everything the team has learned.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the team after, with what was resolved and what still waits.

memorableElement.name: The Pattern Revealed
memorableElement.description: The latest threat is unmistakably connected to all the earlier ones, and whoever is behind them steps forward. The reveal happens; the protagonist chooses whether to strike now, investigate further, or bargain.
setup_hooks: Recurring symbols, methods, or victims that seem like coincidence
The villain observing or occasionally helping in earlier episodes
Team members noticing details that don't add up but dismissing them

name: Cabin in the woods (Isolation Survival Horror)
storyPrompt:
A small group is trapped in an isolated location—cabin, island, oil rig, research station, or similar—cut off from help as something hunts them. Every noise, shadow, and creaking floorboard tightens the noose as trust frays and survival demands terrible choices.
***Thematic Hook:*** Survivors trapped in a remote, inescapable setting must confront an escalating threat, dwindling resources, and mounting paranoia as they realize that no rescue is coming and not everyone will make it out alive.
***Narrative Scope:*** Contained, Location-bound.
***Tone:*** Claustrophobic, Tense, Grim, Paranoid.
***Literary Devices:*** Foreshadowing: Ominous noises, missing supplies, strange signs. Symbolism: Flickering lights, locked doors, encroaching darkness. Irony: Safety measures becoming traps.
***Subgenre:*** Survival horror, Siege horror, Remote outpost horror.
***Pacing:*** Tense with bursts of violence or panic; quiet stretches of dread between incidents.
***Structure:*** Initial arrival or entrapment, escalating attacks and paranoia, final stand or escape attempt.
***Priority:*** Atmosphere and tension > Survival stakes > Mystery of the threat.

phasePrompts.escalation: The threat escalates; supplies and trust dwindle. The group argues over whether to fortify, flee, or confront it.
phasePrompts.climax: Force the final stand or escape attempt, where the nature of the threat is clearest and sacrifices can't be avoided.
phasePrompts.resolution: Show the survivors, and what they carry away from the place.

memorableElement.name: The Monster Among Us

setup_hooks: Characters behaving strangely or disappearing at suspicious moments
Evidence suggesting the threat knows their plans and movements too well
Earlier close calls that were actually narrow misses from within the group
